submittedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render one complete readable desktop DooKnow directory page, about 1440x1000. Image 1 is actual directory content/geometry; Image 2 is global-header hierarchy and flat compact style. Preserve the real DooKnow book identity and full horizontal global header as in Image 2. A narrow left owner rail has account O, 笔记/最近/收藏/应用, bottom 回收站/设置. Keep the contextual sidebar and its search field, 新建 split button, contextual heading, add-folder and refresh icons, and resize divider. No invented navigation or header actions. Select 笔记 in rail and 00-Inbox in contextual notebook tree; include 30-Knowledge below.
Main preserve Image 1 directory screen: breadcrumb 00-Inbox, title 00-Inbox, count 0 个文件夹 · 2 篇笔记. Top actions 新建笔记, 新建文件夹, 导入 Markdown. Table columns 名称/类型/修改时间, two Markdown rows 界面盘点样例.md and 界面盘点样例-72ab64c8.md with example dates and each row's … menu. Beneath table preserve file helper icon and 选择文件即可打开编辑. Keep all regions visible, no modal or extra controls. Flat white #ffffff main/header, #f7f8fa context sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #e6e9f1 thin borders, #4566c6 blue and #edf1ff selection. Crisp Chinese sans-serif, 8px corners, no texture/gradient. No browser chrome, ToDoo/task identity, notifications or fictional navigation. Source/role/state caption is metadata.
